claims.statement: The ministry dates this period to approximately 332 BCE–30 BCE.
Alexander’s conquest was followed by rule under Ptolemy and his successors.

evidence.note: Approximate period boundaries follow the Egyptian ministry. Other entries use museum chronologies, so boundaries can overlap or leave small gaps; these are dating differences, not evidence that nothing happened. The 332 BCE start includes Macedonian rule before Ptolemy became king.
